recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: AI agents sketching arrows and boxes directly on your screen
cloud network stacks laid bare in long-form technical writeups
October fog rolling through San Francisco after dark
autumn sunset creeping earlier, dusk before seven
classrooms straining as a new school year settles in

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Collect glowing agent arrows before they dissolve into fog — each one you grab paints a fragment of a blueprint on screen.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every arrow captured adds a piece to a diagram that assembles in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, arrows scatter faster and spawn decoy flickers

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap when cargo crates lock into rhythm at a fog-shrouded pier — a sunrise shipping game where timing is the only input.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect streaks trigger a golden sunrise burst that clears the whole dock
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beats accelerate and phantom crates add fake tap windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor dawn gradients bleeding through fog

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Trace routes through a live cloud network diagram without crossing failed nodes — a one-thumb path puzzle inspired by infrastructure deep dives.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace connections between nodes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each completed route lights one region of the stack map
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: nodes fail mid-draw and latency ghosts duplicate your line
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: terminal green on deep navy schematic

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves across a foggy windshield to reveal hidden shipping symbols underneath — physics clears the glass one swipe at a time.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to flick leaves off the glass
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each cleared patch reveals one character of a dawn manifest
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gusts redirect leaves and the glass re-fogs over faster
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout leaves on frosted glass
